newsitem.title: USA: Enex ups semi-annual div, sets buyback.
newsitem.headline: Enex ups semi-annual div, sets buyback.

text.p: Enex Resources Corp on Wednesday raised its semi-annual cash dividend to $0.15 per share, up from the previous dividend of $0.10 per share.
The dividend is payable on Dec. 19, 1996 to shareholders of record on Dec. 13, 1996.
For the full year 1996, the total dividend paid will be $0.25 per share, a 25 percent increase from $0.20 in 1995, Enex said.
The company also said it would repurchase 50,000 shares of its common stock in the open market. Enex currently has 1.35 million shares outstanding.
Enex acquires and operates producing oil and gas properties and manages oil and gas income programs.
